_doc: Key art of /proto/: 3 illustration windows over the world, anchored to stable layout objects.
peak = anchor z + peak_offset; presence 1 within `core` metres of camera z from the peak, smooth to 0 at `range` (the cards' function).
Windows live only where the route is free: no content card, no camera focus beyond a tail (<= 0.05), no transition dim,
out before the ground blend leaving the slot's biome (tools/key_art.py checks it).
master: the approved art (PNG, exact bytes of the art batch); src: the runtime WebP derived from it by tools/key_art.py.
tools/key_art.py writes the static <figure>s into proto/index.html (alt EN in the HTML, RU in data-alt-ru); main.js only
sets presence and assigns src when the camera is within range + lazy.preload_ahead_m of the peak.
Display: 480x320 css at a 1280x800 desktop, soft-edged (CSS mask), no frame. /proto/?debug=keyart outlines the windows.

activation.exit_core / exit_range (optional): the fade on the far side of the peak, when it differs; yields_to: a world object the window must be gone before (gap_m metres of route) it enters the frame.

alt.en: Villagers going about their day by the tavern: one unloads goods from a cart, two shop at a striped market stall, two talk at the tavern door.
alt.ru: Деревня живёт своей жизнью у таверны: один разгружает повозку, двое у полосатого прилавка, двое беседуют у двери таверны.

slots.why: the village on screen is empty of people; the copy says the world lives without you (NPCs haul, haggle, drink) - the picture shows that life. Right after the tavern focus (focus weight <= 0.03), while the ground is still the village's: out before the village->forest ground blend starts (z -114)

alt.en: A miner swings a pickaxe beside a boulder with a rust-coloured ore vein, near a timber mine entrance, a brazier and a cart of ore.
alt.ru: Шахтёр с киркой у валуна с рыжей рудной жилой, рядом вход в штольню, жаровня и вагонетка с рудой.

slots.why: props show a mine, not work in it: ore pulled out by hands, veins running out, the haul - after the adit focus, by the deep adit, before the spirit crossing

alt.en: A spectral ship of the dead, pale blue and translucent, drifts on low mist over the mossy ground of the spirit world; a small ghost stands nearby among dead trees and gravestones.
alt.ru: Призрачный корабль мёртвых, бледно-голубой и полупрозрачный, плывёт в низком тумане над моховой землёй мира духов; рядом маленький призрак, мёртвые деревья и надгробия.

slots.why: the camera never frames the ship of the dead (x -21.6, too wide for a focus); the copy rides it - the picture comes first, then the card 'Death is a place' and the crypt; peak moved to -440 and the exit shortened (-445 -> -453) so the illustrated ship is gone before the world ship enters the frame (-455.95): art ship -> a few metres of world -> world ship. Entry shortened to -423 to stay out of the mine->spirit dim (to -422)

rejected.why: no forest subject in the site copy ('Skills, no levels' is not about the forest); the dead-oak focus carries the biome
the final house is the culmination and the end of the route; a picture would cover the finale
the opening frame of the page; the world must speak first
30 m before the spirit->home crossing - a second spirit picture, too close to the first and to the transition
